text:
rahul: Heads-up — sync for SI + edge partner onboarding tomorrow 10am PT. Need to lock trainer roster, HW kit shipping windows, and marketplace listing TL;DR. Can folks confirm availability?

maria: I can do 10am. Need to confirm if we have new playbook ver for edge deployments (air-gapped).

dina: +1. Also want to align cert requirements — lab pass/fail criteria unclear in doc today.

samir: On trainer roster: me, olivia, and julia (contractor) available. Will need lab access tokens for julia.

maria: julia needs VPN + temporary KMS key. Is ops okay with that?

olivia: Ops: fine as long as we scope keys to sandbox and rotate after cohort. Send request via infra-ticket.

rahul: Prefer keeping secrets out of emails. Dina — can you draft the cert rubric? Short checklist: deploy, inference run, telemetry, rollback test.

dina: Will do. Draft ETA EOD. Short checklist: 1) base model deploy, 2) end-to-end latency under target, 3) KV cache validation, 4) fallback to cloud variant, 5) audit log present.

maria: For the marketplace listing, legal wants a single product brief + approved logos. We also need a one-click deploy template (CloudFormation/Terraform).

samir: I can lead the CFN template. Quick question: do we publish a quantized variant? That affects the bundle size for the marketplace.

olivia: Recommend shipping both standard and quantized artifacts. Put quantized as "optional" in the listing. Mention GPU requirements.

rahul: Logistics: HW kits — shipping to SI trainers in US/EU only for Q2. Ops cost estimate?

olivia: Ops: estimate ~ $1.4k per kit (GPU node, power/monitor dongles, preloaded image). Need approval from partnerships budget.

maria: Also want to run a pilot hands-on lab before wide rollout. Proposal: 8 trainers, 3-day cohort, two labs: private deploy + marketplace publish.

dina: Add an evening "shadow trainer" session for partner engineers to pair with our trainers. That improved pass rates last time.

rahul: Good. Who owns the playbook update and the slide deck for the pilot?

maria: I'll own the deck. Dina will own playbook ops section. Samir owns infra artifacts. Olivia will handle kit shipping and cost.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — infra-ticket #INFR-842 created for julia VPN/KMS access (expires in 14 days).

samir: For lab verification we should include a tiny smoke test script partners can run:

samir: ```bash
# smoke test to confirm inference and GPU access
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-edge-1","input":"Hello"}' | jq .
# check GPU
ssh trainer@kit 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv'
```

maria: Love it. Put that in the playbook appendix.

dina: Certification note: do we accept recorded demos for any part of the rubric? Some partner customers are restricted on shipping kits.

olivia: We can accept recorded demos for deployment steps, but rollback and telemetry checks must be live or done via our sandbox with logs.

rahul: Timeline: draft rubic EOD (dina), CFN + smoke script by Wed (samir), deck by Thu (maria), ops budget signoff by Fri (olivia). Pilot cohort week after next.

maria: I'll create a short signup form for partner seats (Google form link in the deck).

dina: Also add a short evaluation rubric that trainers complete per participant (pass/fail + notes).

samir: Heads-up: for air-gapped installs we need validated container manifests pinned to SHA. I'll add step in playbook: manifest pinning + offline image tarball generation.

rahul: Perfect. Last: joint announcement — Partnerships wants a single PR window aligned with marketplace listing. Do we want a private beta announcement first?

maria: Recommend private beta to 3 SIs first, gather success metrics, then broader announce. Keeps support load manageable.

olivia: Agreed. Ops can support 3 concurrent kits for the pilot.

rahul: Cool. I'll send calendar invite and a short pre-read with links to current playbook + marketplace checklist. Link anything else here and I'll bake into the pre-read. :thumbsup:

maria: Pre-read link: https://redwoodhq.internal/docs/si-edge-playbook (will update after Dina's rubric).

dina: Uploading draft rubric to that page in 30m.

olivia: Filed budget request: PARTN-443. Tracking there.

rahul: Thanks team — see you at 10am PT.
